name: Propylene glycol phenyl ether
description: Propylene glycol phenyl ether (CAS 41593-38-8 ), also known as 1-(2-Methylphenoxy)-2-propanol, is a slow-evaporating glycol ether solvent used across coatings, cleaning, and polymer formulation. Its controlled evaporation rate and compatibility with a broad range of resins make it a preferred choice where film formation and flow need to be managed precisely in industrial settings. In architectural and industrial coatings, it functions as a coalescing agent and flow promoter, improving film leveling in waterborne and solvent-based systems for better surface finishes. Formulators of hard-surface and industrial cleaners incorporate it to boost soil penetration and surfactant efficiency in concentrated products, ensuring high performance in heavy-duty applications. In adhesive and sealant systems, it supports resin dissolution and workability, extending open time in reactive formulations to allow for more precise application and bonding. Plastics processors use it as a plasticizer and processing aid where temporary softening or compatibility with polymer matrices is required during the manufacturing of various components. Propylene glycol phenyl ether is supplied as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes. It is available in technical grade for standard use. This grade is the standard specification for coatings, cleaning, and polymer applications. Purity levels and moisture content are typically controlled to meet formulation-sensitive end uses.
